item.title: A Second Look: Megyn's 2023 Sitdown with Gov. Ron DeSantis (Ad-Free)
item.description:
Megyn Kelly brings the latest episode of the "A Second Look" series, featuring her 2023 sitdown with Gov. Ron DeSantis back when he was running for president the first time - as he re-enters the national political conversation this week.
